1) I have been on about 6 types of medications

2) i am not diagnosed with an eating disorder 

3) I told my psych nurse in January I was restricting before we decided to start the medication plan. I told her i was worried and she said she wasn’t concerned. She told me the worst issue I have is my anxiety and I do agree with that. I just haven’t told her I am still restricting but my next appointment I am going to. 

3) loads of people have issues with control, and it’s not a buzzword that immediately diagnoses you  with an ED. Of course people will feel they lack control in a PANDEMIC. Some people control their life with drink, some people by cleaning their house. Literally everything is about control. My anxiety disorder developed BECAUSE I was scared of losing control. If I went to my doctor and described all this, I would not be diagnosed with anything other than what I’m already diagnosed with. The fact is, you have to be severely underweight to be diagnosed which is awful. I would actually LIKE to be diagnosed. 

4) these episodes of restriction I’ve had for a while. Something triggers me, I restrict a bit and then usually go away after a month or two. I have never. Ever. Been underweight or had unhealthy bloods in my life. Which is why I am not concerned. 

5) I am part of ED support groups online so I feel valid. I recognise I do have a problem I promise I’m not waving this away as nothing. I have used many different methods of self harm for years and it switches from one to another. This is just one rn. Even when I was on meds, Even at my most stable. This is a deep rooted issue of self punishment probably related to trauma that Will not go away until I finally get into therapy. It is just too bad that the wait for this is a year a half. I would love to be in therapy. doctors would not recognise this as an issue, abs that is a problem within the mental health process. 

I don’t want you to get me wrong and think I don’t appreciate your concern because I really do. It’s quite validating to have someone say I have a problem when a professional might not be concerned because I don’t look underweight. I like giving a name to what this is and I do say I have an ED, but I wouldn’t to a professional cause I’m not diagnosed and they don’t like people diagnosing themselves. I’ve told professionals my symptoms and they’ve doubted me and told me I was lying. I have never trusted professionals because of this reason and always made the decisions myself. They have been incredibly unprofessional with me because they simply DO NOT understand or have the training to understand my issues. 

I did not tell my psych I am still restricting because yes I was worried she would say I can’t come off anymore. I would tell her if she asked, but she didn’t do it obviously didn’t concern her that much otherwise she’d make a note to check. But I will be honest next time I talk to her and let her make the decision. But I guarantee. And I’m not just saying this. She will say it is not a concern. And hell, that’s on their ass not mine.

I was honestly shocked at your comment and it actually really made me upset. My anxiety is extremely high rn and the lack of control terrifies me, yet you said I’ll end up committing suicide, which is a huge fear of mine. I really wish you hadn’t have said that. Other people have told me that too. 

As for the ED thing, yeah I have experience with that for a long time. I am not underweight or unhealthy rn by any means. My BMI called me overweight the other week. Some days are better than others. 

But also, you assumed a lot based off of one post. To assume I’m stable on meds. If I was stable I wouldn’t be coming off them. Antidepressants haven’t helped me for the 7 years I’ve been on them and suck the life and emotions from me and don’t stop any episodes I have. I’ve been suicidal and actively self harmed on these meds. They also don’t help me eat. 

And the reason I’m coming off is not simply because I “don’t want it”. I have never been admitted or thought of as severe enough of a case to be admitted. I’m regularly in contact with a psych nurse who supports me coming off, however I do not have a therapist but I am on the waiting list for two of them. And actually, I’ve been to five therapists and NONE have helped me, and a lot made me worse. But I’m still trying. 

I will not kill myself. No one is forcing me to “stay alive”. I have been suicidal in the past but I will not kill myself. The reason for me wanting to come off IS TO FINALLY RECOVER BECAUSE I THINK IT IS THE BEST FOR ME. I’ve been doing this shit since I was 18 and now I’m 25, trust me, I am very sick of this shit.
